profile.headline: SDE @ Amazon
profile.summary:
"Your level of success will rarely exceed your level of personal development, because success is something you attract by the person you become."
-Jim Rohn

https://www.amazon.jobs/en/business_categories/amazongo

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
● Migrated custom web applications from old code base (Knockout) to new code base built on Angular
● Developed enhancements and new features to said web applications to meet business needs
● Maintained and deployed code through Azure DevOps and Azure Portal

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: ● Moved to intern role to pursue higher education while maintaining employment status

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
● Created and analyzed data reports in both Dynamics CRM for business development and Oracle HCM for HR
● Researched and troubleshot issues, applied system patches and hot fixes, and monitored and updated system resources as needed for both Dynamics CRM and Kentico CMS (www.bdo.com)
● Collaborated with database administrators, business analysts and associates from different departments to develop applications and enhancements for the aforementioned software

positions.title: Student Research Assistant, Center for Social Research
positions.locationName: Raybrook Building 2041, Suite 103 Grand Rapids, MI 49546
positions.description:
● Created data analyses, innovative data visualizations and performed qualitative research tasks for off-campus clients and Calvin faculty.
● Co-wrote and helped maintain Qual2DB (https://github.com/calvincsr/qual2db).
● Demonstrated flexibility in responding to new research opportunities as they arose.
● Exhibited adaptability to learn new software, research methods, and work routines quickly.

positions.title: Hekman Library Student Worker
positions.description:
● Student worker at the Hekman Library Circulation Desk.
● Assisted patrons with various library services such as finding research material, retrieving books, checking out books and more.
● Completed everyday library tasks such as shelving books, answering phone calls and restocking printing paper.

positions.title: Technical Specialist Intern
positions.description:
● Implemented a more efficient process to accelerate the roll out of over 60 new Dell XPS computers to all staff
● Provided customer support by solving difficult IT and computer related problems for dozens of staff members
